AlwaysCountdown: Always Show Countdown in Level Editor
EnablePausePlanetTrail: Show Planet Trail in Pause Menu
RestartRequired: Takes effect after restarting the game
LobbyMusicHint: Some changes may require re-entering lobby to fully apply.
EnableNoFailTooEarly: Deadly Decorations Become Purple 'Too Early' Hits in No Fail
ScaleFilterSpeedWithPitch: Scale Effect Speed with Song Pitch
ForceAngleData: Force use of angleData when loading Level
SkipEventIfPaused: Ignore all events when game not started
SkipEventIfPausedWarning: Enabling this will cause all events to be ignored in editor preview before the level starts playing, including track colors, position tracks, and move tracks (does not affect actual gameplay)
SkipEventIfPausedWarningDetail: During level preview, track colors/positions and event icons are in their initial state
FirstRunMessage: Iridium is an optimization mod, but it still has unstable situations. If there are problems with the game, please consider disabling it first.
UpgradeMessage_1_0_6_beta5: 1.0.6_beta5 has rewritten some patches, which may change the experience of some features. If you encounter issues, please revert to the previous version immediately.
OptimizerDescription: Optimize game performance by reducing memory usage and improving rendering efficiency
LevelSelectDescription: Configure level select screen and lobby music settings
CompatibilityDescription: Enable compatibility fixes for older level formats and behaviors
HitSoundDescription: Customize hit sound and judge text display
PatchManagerUsingCache: Using cached bindings to remove {0} ({1} bindings)
OptimizeFfxDecorations: Optimize Ffx Decorations (High Experimental, Reduce Update Frequency)
DOTweenOptimizationWarning: Enabling this may affect effect behavior
DOTweenOptimizationRestartRequired: To fully restore after disabling, please restart the game
ExtremeOptimizationHint: Extreme optimization spreads the creation of large amounts of tweens across multiple frames to reduce stutter. Intended for levels with huge numbers of decorations; it is experimental and not recommended to enable.
UseILPatchHint: IL Transpiler mode: Direct IL injection, best performance
UsePrefixPostfixHint: Prefix/Postfix mode: Standard Harmony patches, best compatibility
FrameSpreadLoadingHint: Spreads decoration creation across multiple frames to prevent lag when loading levels with many decorations
OptimizeParticleInactive: Skip Inactive/Off-screen Particles (Also enables Object Pooling)
FixJudgeRotation: Fix Missing Rotation on Non-Perfect Judgements
FixCoopPauseLock: Fix Coop Pause Beat Locking Other Players
FixTurnaroundCondition: Fix Pause Beat Timing on Hairpin Turn Floors
EditorPauseKeyHint: Press this key during auto-play to pause/resume. Click the button then press a keyboard key to bind
IncrementalFloorInsert: Incremental Floor Insert/Delete (Skip full path rebuild)
OptimizeOffsetFloorEvents: Optimize Floor ID Offset in Events
EditorFloorOptimizationWarning: These optimizations alter the editor's floor rebuild logic. If you encounter visual glitches, disable them.
EditorShortcutsHint: Click the key button to bind a new key. Click the modifier button (right side) to cycle through combinations (C=Ctrl, A=Alt, S=Shift).
CustomEasingEngineHint: Handles Move Track / Recolor Track / Move Decorations with a lightweight custom easing engine instead of the engine ADOFAI currently uses. Mutually exclusive with the individual optimization options above.
CustomEasingEngineConflictDetected: Custom Easing Engine was auto-disabled due to conflicting optimization settings. Please re-enable it after disabling MoveTrack/RecolorTrack/MoveDecoration optimizations.
AsyncInputHint: Improves audio timing accuracy and reduces input lag by using high-precision system timers. Recommended for high BPM / dense levels.
AsyncInputWarning: Warning: Levels played with this feature enabled must be clearly marked. The Iridium development team assumes no responsibility for any consequences arising from unmarked levels.
IgnoreRequiredModsWarning: Required third-party mods will be ignored. The level may not play correctly.
CustomEventReadOnlyNotice: These events only work when the third-party mod is installed. You can only disable or remove them.
EnableOptimizerInfo: Master switch for Iridium's optimizations. When disabled, every option below is ignored and the game runs exactly as vanilla.
CompressImageInfo: Compresses custom level textures (backgrounds, decorations) while loading to reduce graphics memory usage. Turn off if the picture visibly degrades.
ShowSavedMemoryInfo: Shows how much graphics memory texture compression saved when a level loads.
UseLossyCompressionInfo: Uses DXT lossy compression instead of lossless. Much lower memory usage with slight quality loss; useful for GPUs with little memory.
LossyQualityInfo: Quality of lossy texture compression (10-100). Lower values save more memory but introduce more artifacts.
MultipleOf4Info: Resizes textures to multiples of 4 pixels so the GPU's block compression can be applied efficiently.
DivideImageByInfo: Shrinks every custom texture by this factor before compression (2 = half width and height). Higher saves more memory but lowers sharpness.
DontResizeColliderInfo: Keeps decoration colliders at their original size even after textures are shrunk, so decorations that rely on hitboxes keep working.
DisableShadowsInfo: Forces real-time shadows off while the optimizer is enabled. Real-time shadows are expensive; turning them off usually gains FPS.
OptimizeDecorationUpdateInfo: Remembers each decoration's components up front instead of searching for them again on every update.
OptimizeTileUpdateInfo: Remembers each tile's components up front and skips unnecessary steps while tiles update.
OptimizeMoveTrackInfo: Speeds up MoveTrack events: the track's components are found once instead of being searched again throughout the movement.
OptimizeRecolorTrackInfo: Speeds up RecolorTrack events by remembering track components and skipping unnecessary recolor work.
SkipEventIfPausedInfo: Skips applying chart events to tiles while the game is paused or hasn't started yet. See the warning above for how this affects editor previews.
OptimizeEventIconsInfo: Only refreshes a tile's event icon when it actually changes.
OptimizeScnGameUpdateInfo: Lightens the game's main per-frame update: fewer repeated checks, searches, and memory allocations every frame.
OptimizeMoveDecorationsInfo: Applies MoveDecorations events in batches instead of walking through decorations one by one.
OptimizeFfxDecorationsInfo: Skips updates for off-screen or completely still effect decorations. Note: complex effect-heavy levels may look slightly out of sync.
OptimizeFloorMeshInfo: Reuses saved tile shape data and only rebuilds a tile's mesh when its shape actually changes.
OptimizeFiltersInfo: Caches the per-decoration filter render (RT blit chain): decorations whose filters are unchanged skip the per-frame blits. Filter parameter tweens and filter events invalidate the cache automatically; filters that animate by themselves (VHS, noise, rain/snow, glitch, etc.) are never cached.
FastLoadingInfo: Trims part of the loading routine (applying events, creating objects, etc.) so levels load faster.
EnableCustomEasingEngineInfo: Processes MoveTrack / RecolorTrack / MoveDecorations with a lightweight built-in easing engine instead of DOTween. Mutually exclusive with those individual optimize toggles above.
OptimizeParticleInfo: Master switch for the particle optimizations below.
OptimizeParticleInactiveInfo: Skips simulating inactive particle systems and keeps them for reuse instead of destroying and recreating them.
OptimizeParticleCullingInfo: Pauses particle simulation while its emitter is outside the visible area.
OptimizeParticleLodInfo: Automatically reduces particle counts when many particle systems are emitting at once.
OptimizeEventProcessingInfo: Sorts chart events into groups at load time so the game can quickly skip ones it doesn't need during play.
OptimizeEditorMouseDetectionInfo: Lets the editor find what's under your mouse without checking every tile and decoration one at a time.
OptimizeEditorEventIndicatorsInfo: Only redraws editor event indicator UI when the selection actually changes.
OptimizeMoveTrackTweensInfo: Creates MoveTrack tweens only when needed and in batches, so loading doesn't stall on levels containing thousands of them.
BatchMoveDecorationsInfo: Moves decorations in batched updates instead of handling them one at a time.
CustomLevelReadOptimizationInfo: Reads .adofai level files faster by cutting unnecessary intermediate work while parsing.
FrameSpreadDecorationLoadingInfo: Spawns level decorations over several frames instead of all at once, preventing long freezes when loading heavy levels.
DecorationsPerFrameInfo: How many decorations to create per frame while frame-spread loading is active (10-500).
EnableDOTweenOptimizationInfo: Tunes DOTween globally: sets aside tween objects in advance and simplifies setup, so animation handling causes less stutter.
TweenerCapacityInfo: How many tweens DOTween prepares capacity for up front (200-2000). Set close to how many usually run at the same time in your level.
SequenceCapacityInfo: How many sequences DOTween prepares capacity for up front (50-500).
DOTweenDefaultRecyclableInfo: New tweens are reusable by default: finished ones go back to the pool instead of being thrown away.
DOTweenDisableSafeModeInfo: Turns off DOTween's safety checks. Slightly faster, but problems caused by destroyed targets now surface as errors instead of being silently ignored.
EnableExtremeOptimizationInfo: Spreads heavy work such as tween creation across multiple frames. For extreme levels with tens of thousands of objects.
MaxTweensPerFrameInfo: Maximum tweens created per frame while Extreme Optimization is on (50-500). Lower means steadier frames but slower total loading.
BasicMemoryOptimizationInfo: The memory cleanup features used to be scattered across switches — they are now merged into this one. Just turn it on. Fine-tuning: Config/FerriteCore.json.
EnableVirtualMemoryOptimizationInfo: Moves unused memory to the virtual memory (page file) on disk to free up RAM. Same principle as PCL2's memory optimization. Windows only — use with caution on HDDs.
VmTrimWindowsOnlyHint: Windows only; use with caution on mechanical hard drives.
VmTrimOnLevelLoadInfo: Frees the memory left behind by the menu and the previous level when entering a level.
VmTrimOnEditorEnterInfo: Frees leftover memory when entering the editor.
OptimizePlayerInputAllocationsInfo: Removes repeated memory allocations in player input handling, preventing stutters caused by constant input polling.
OptimizeRDInputAllocationsInfo: Removes repeated memory allocations from rebuilding the input key list.
OptimizeGameplayAllocationsInfo: Eliminates the memory garbage the game creates every frame (planet hitbox checks, track color animation, filter calls) to reduce hitches. No visual or gameplay changes.
RemoveNewsInfo: Hides the news panel on the main menu.
ForceDifficultyUIInfo: Forces the difficulty selector UI to show in CLS levels, where vanilla may hide it in some levels.
AlwaysCountdownInfo: Plays the countdown when starting play-testing in the editor, where the game normally skips it.
EnablePausePlanetTrailInfo: Keeps the pause planets' motion trail visible when the pause menu opens (the game normally disables it).
EnableCircleArcInfo: Faithful rounded-corner visuals: turns within the configured angle range get the large rounded corner (default 90°~105°, matching vanilla right angles), and you can adjust the range so obtuse turns get the same arc. Near-straight turns close to 180° stay as vanilla.
ShowAutoplayHintUIInfo: Shows an on-screen hint overlay during autoplay.
CustomAutoplayHintInfo: Replaces the built-in autoplay hint text with your own template.
MoveAutoplayTextInfo: Unlocks the position of the autoplay status text so you can move it anywhere with the X/Y sliders below.
EnableJudgeTextCustomizationInfo: Customize judgement texts (Perfect, TooEarly...) including showing exact timing via {offset}.
EnableLegacyPauseFixInfo: (No longer applicable, but kept anyway) Restores the v2.9.3 pause logic for compatibility with older charts and mods.
EnableNoFailTooEarlyInfo: Under No Fail, hitting a deadly decoration becomes a purple 'TooEarly' judgement instead of instant death.
ScaleFilterSpeedWithPitchInfo: Effect animation speed follows the pitch (playback rate), so visuals stay in sync when speed changes.
FixCameraRelativeDragInfo: Fixes decoration dragging offset when the camera is rotated or zoomed in the editor.
PortalTravelFixInfo: Ignores repeated portal triggers while a level transition is already running, preventing state corruption.
FixEditorPlayResetMistakesInfo: Resets the mistake counter correctly when starting play-testing from the editor.
FixTurnaroundConditionInfo: Aligns turnaround detection with v2.9.8 behavior, fixing misjudged turnarounds in edge cases.
FixJudgeRotationInfo: Fixes judge text not rotating for non-Perfect judgements in single player.
FixCoopPauseLockInfo: Applies the pause beat lock per player in co-op mode instead of locking everyone globally.
ForceAngleDataInfo: Legacy charts have their angle data read as-is instead of being auto-corrected.
UseILPatchInfo: IL Transpiler mode: direct IL injection, best performance. Turn off for Prefix/Postfix mode: standard Harmony patches, best compatibility.
IgnoreRequiredModsInfo: Skips the required-mods check so you can join lobbies without installing every listed mod. May cause missing features or crashes.
EnableHitSoundPitchInfo: Hit sounds follow the music pitch/speed setting instead of playing at fixed pitch.
EnableAsyncInputInfo: Improves audio timing accuracy and reduces input latency using high-precision system timers. Recommended for high BPM / dense charts.
EnableLobbyMusicPatchInfo: Enables lobby music customization below. Some changes may require re-entering the lobby to fully apply.
EnableCustomBpmInfo: Overrides the BPM used for lobby music sync.
LobbyFastMusicInfo: Uses a separate faster music track in the lobby when game speed is above 1x.
LobbyCustomMusicInfo: Replaces lobby music with your own audio files configured below.
EnableEditorShortcutsInfo: Adds editor keyboard shortcuts for decoration selection and navigation (listed below).
CameraFollowOnFloorSelectInfo: Moves the editor camera to the selected floor when using Go To Floor / Select All Floors.
EditorPauseAllowedInfo: Allows pausing/resuming while auto-playing inside the editor.
EditorPauseEnabledInfo: Enables the custom pause key binding below during editor autoplay.
EnableEditorFloorOptimizationInfo: Master switch for editor floor performance optimizations below. Recommended when editing very long charts.
IncrementalFloorInsertInfo: Inserting/deleting floors only touches nearby floors instead of rebuilding the whole level.
RangeBasedRedrawInfo: After edits, only redraws holds/planets/numbers within the affected range instead of everything.
SkipRedundantRemakePathInfo: Skips track path rebuilds when nothing visually changed.
OptimizeOffsetFloorEventsInfo: Avoids repeatedly scanning the entire event list.
OptimizeDecorationShaderCacheInfo: Skips the per-frame material writes for decorations whose color/opacity/tile/visibility have not changed. Big win on charts with hundreds of static decorations. Decorations with masks are excluded; filtered decorations are handled by the filter optimization.
EnableStaticDecorationBatchingInfo: Replaces the individual renderers of static unfiltered decorations with one batched mesh per atlas page — draw calls drop from thousands to a few. Requires the custom easing engine (for tween awareness). Decorations with filters, masks, tiling or non-default blend modes keep the vanilla path. If anything looks misplaced or stacking order is wrong, disable it.
ShowPerfOverlayInfo: Shows a small on-screen readout: FPS, 1% low, draw calls, script/tween time and how many decorations are batched. For diagnosing where frame time actually goes.
